claim_one_line: THE 3D INDEX OF THE OBJECT IS COMPUTED, and the record's own outside bench had conceded the gap in those words ('the 3d index of T[m004] was NOT computed'). Built from scratch in exact integer arithmetic on q^(1/2): the Dimofte-Gaiotto-Gukov tetrahedron index in the Garoufalidis convention (stated, because two transposed conventions circulate), then the gluing, with SnapPy supplying only the gluing-equation rows. I_m004(0,0) = 1 - 2q - 3q^2 + 2q^3 + 8q^4 + 18q^5 + 18q^6 + 14q^7 - 12q^8 - 52q^9 - 106q^10 - ..., computed to q^35 and NOT equal to 1; every coefficient published by Garoufalidis-Hodgson-Hoffman-Rubinstein (Illinois J. Math. 60 (2016) 289-352, pp. 297-298) reproduces exactly, all EIGHT published boundary classes of m004 reproduce including the half-integer-power ones, and m009 reproduces their section 11.5. THE FINDING: m004 and its SIBLING m003 carry the SAME series term for term despite different first homology (Z against Z/5+Z), and this is proved from the threefold symmetry applied twice, not observed numerically; across twelve census manifolds the index takes 7 distinct values grouped exactly by volume. So the relay's 'a different index on the same objects, and it is not trivial' is TRUE and the index is nevertheless SILENT on the one distinction this programme needs it for -- the m004/m003 pair whose Chern-Simons orbit is {0, 1/4} -- at least on the (0,0) class; whether another boundary class separates them is OPEN and computable. A real bug was found and fixed in the building: uniform truncation of the product loses terms because gluing factors can have negative minimal degree, which made the answer depend on WHICH EDGE WEIGHT was set to zero, wrong for five manifolds and right for m004 by luck. After the fix, edge-choice independence 12/12, cyclic-order independence, and 30/30 random retriangulations agree. Symmetries tested rather than assumed: I(m,e)=I(e,m) FALSE, I(m,e)=I(-m,-e) FALSE, bare triality FALSE; I(m,e)=I(-e,-m) holds and the threefold symmetry holds only with its prefactor. NOT DONE: no direct 1-efficiency test (no Regina on this bench).
